_about: Acetone (1) + N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (2): isothermal total pressures at 333.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of acetone, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.
